mechanism: A single-threaded event loop: call stack, then microtasks (promises), then rendering, then macrotasks (timers, I/O). Web Workers are separate event loops, not shared-memory threads by default.
why: The UI thread cannot block; I/O had to be multiplexed without pthreads in the page.
useWhen: All browser JS and Node unless you opt into worker_threads.
price: One blocked turn freezes the page; CPU parallelism requires workers and structured clone or SharedArrayBuffer.
